name: Viera Residences
paymentPlan: 20%: Down payment at sales launch; 80% During construction
overview: Viera Residences, developed by Vantage Ventures Real Estate, is a premier residential project designed to offer luxurious and contemporary living in the heart of Dubai Production City. With its modern architecture, smart home technology, and world-class amenities, Viera Residences is set to provide an unparalleled living experience for professionals, families, and investors. Located in one of Dubai's fastest-growing districts, this project combines convenience, elegance, and sustainability, making it an exceptional choice for those looking to embrace the future of urban living.
